description: This Java class demonstrates how to wrap a layout inside a ScrollView in Android. It dynamically adds TextViews and Buttons to a LinearLayout within the activity's layout.

classes.name: ScrollView2
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates wrapping a layout in a ScrollView by dynamically adding TextView and Button elements.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and programmatically adds TextViews and Buttons to a LinearLayout.
